name: Cloro
summary: API that reads AI search engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini, Grok, AI Overview and Google Search — and returns the sources and citations behind every query as structured JSON.
best_for: SEO and marketing teams who need AI-search visibility as structured data — who gets cited for which query on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini and Google's AI Overview — rather than as a dashboard someone else designed
skip_if: you want a finished rank-tracking dashboard rather than an API; this returns JSON with markdown, sources and citations, and you build the reporting yourself
honest_knock: The free tier is a sampler, not a trial of the real thing: 500 credits is about 100 async ChatGPT answers at the 5-credit rate we were actually charged, and their table lists 7 for a full response. Fewer, if you call it synchronously -- and one concurrent job means you queue. Anyone running a daily visibility check across a hundred keywords burns through it in about two days. Read the credit table before the price table -- the same $100 buys 250,000 credits, which is 35,700 full ChatGPT calls or 62,500 Perplexity ones, so your engine mix decides your bill more than your plan does. And nothing carries: their FAQ, read 17 September 2026, states that unused credits expire at the end of every cycle, so a quiet month is money gone rather than headroom for a busy one.

pricing.notes: (prices re-read 2026-09-17 on cloro.dev/pricing) Credit-metered, and the credit table matters more than the plan price. Free is $0 for 500 credits a month, one concurrent job and one seat. Paid runs Lite $30 (37,500 credits, $0.80 per 1k, 10 concurrent jobs), Hobby $100 (250,000, $0.40, 20 jobs) and Starter $250 (650,000, $0.39, 50 jobs). Above that come Growth $500 (1,350,000, $0.37, 75 jobs) and Business $1,000 (2,800,000, $0.36, 100 jobs). Four self-serve Enterprise steps follow: $2,000 for 5,871,025 credits at $0.34, $3,000 for 9,306,606 at $0.32, $4,000 for 12,756,261 at $0.31 and $5,000 for 16,391,783 at $0.31, where concurrency reaches 255. Seats are unlimited from Lite up. What a request costs varies by engine. ChatGPT full response is 7 credits, ChatGPT web search 5, Copilot 5, and AI Overview including the SERP 5. Perplexity, Grok, AI Mode and Gemini are 4, and Google Search and Google News 3 plus 2 per extra page. A synchronous call adds 2 credits on top of all of those. Perplexity stood at 3 credits when we read the same table on 17 August 2026. Grok is marked temporarily unavailable, with the page warning that requests to it fail. Credits do not roll over: unused credits expire at the end of the billing cycle, and at zero the API returns 403 until you upgrade or the cycle resets.
